lines.text: 从那以后，他每次设置自动回复，都会在手机上定一个闹钟，提醒自己回来以后把它关掉。
lines.py: cóng nà yǐ hòu, tā měi cì shè zhì zì dòng huí fù, dōu huì zài shǒu jī shàng dìng yí gè nào zhōng, tí xǐng zì jǐ huí lái yǐ hòu bǎ tā guān diào.
lines.en: From then on, whenever he sets an auto-reply, he also sets an alarm on his phone to remind himself to switch it off when he's back.
